$meta.name: boopis design system v7 (proposal)
$meta.status: proposal for the owner; nothing in the app reads this file yet
$meta.source: Grok Bot desktop 1.2.3 measured values (grok-package/grokbot-design/tokens.json, Part A section 2) as the starting values; boopis keeps its character (orb2 orbs, the wordmark and logo, the bots' colours, its vocabulary) and its accessibility floors
$meta.format: each token: css (the custom property the kit reads), dark and light (or value when it does not change with the theme), v6 (what it replaces), grok (the measured source), use. Options the owner picks are in options; defaults below are the recommended pick of each.
$meta.generator: docs/design/v7/build-v7-css.mjs writes tokens.v7.css from this file

ink.use: the one neutral; every text, line and fill below is this ink at an alpha step

bg-sidebar.use: the sidebar and the rail; the deepest surface

bg-chrome.use: the window and the ground the work sits on; the floating chrome sits on it

bg-pane.use: the details panel and other side panes that push the work

bg-elevated.use: cards, settings cards, menus, popovers, dialogs, the composer, tooltips, toasts, floating chrome buttons

bg-elevated-hover.use: a hovered row on an elevated surface; pressed fills; the scrollbar thumb

bg-well.grok: code box of the approval card (sampled)
bg-well.use: wells only: code, terminal output, diffs. Cards are no longer inset (R-colour-4 changes)

dock.use: owner decision kept: the dock is pitch black in both themes and is never themeable

text-strong.use: names, titles, the current row; equal to --text in v7 (kept as a name so modules need no change)

text-dim.use: everything secondary a person must read: descriptions, timestamps, section headings, meta, state words, costs. 7.3:1 on elevated (dark), 5.4:1 (light)

text-quiet.use: placeholders and labelling glyphs only. Never meta a person must read: it is 3.7:1 in light (R-a11y-8). Meta moves to --text-dim

icon.use: glyphs in icon buttons and rows

icon-quiet.use: window controls, the composer's + and mic, labelling glyphs; 3:1 floor holds (5.4 dark, 3.7 light)

mark-off.use: inactive non-text marks (page dots, empty rings): 3.36:1 dark, 3.1:1 light, kept for WCAG 1.4.11

fill-quaternary.use: the faintest wash: skeleton rest, disabled secondary

fill-secondary.use: the composer's round buttons, chips at rest, the agent bubble, letter tiles

hover.use: row, icon button and chip hover

current.use: the selected row, the active nav item, the current rail tile, the highlighted palette row

hair.use: dividers between groups, the agent bubble's ring

line.use: the outline of every elevated thing: floating buttons, menus, dialogs, the composer at rest

line-strong.use: hovered outlines, the composer focused, attachment cards

line-field.use: a text field's outline: kept at 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11); Grok's 22% is the one place v7 does not follow Grok

float-line.grok: dark 6% hairline; light: the shadow's 1px ring, almost nothing
float-line.use: the outline of menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, dialogs and settings cards: in light the shadow carries the edge (light-shadow option A; B 12%, C 18%)

composer-line.use: the composer's outline at rest; focused it takes --line-field

specular.use: the inset top and bottom light on elevated surfaces and the agent bubble, dark only

specular-strong.use: the top-most layer's 1px top highlight (Grok gap 9: stacked dialogs)

selected.use: the primary pill, the send button, the active filter chip: inverted ink

accent.use: owner's pick (09): an indigo; Iris is the placeholder until the owner chooses among the five candidates (options.accent). A fill: the switch on, the chosen option, progress. Editable in a custom theme

accent-text.use: links, the info banner; Iris placeholder: 6.6:1 on #121212, 5.8:1 on #1f1f1f (dark); 7.1:1 on white, 6.5:1 on #f5f5f5 (light)

on-accent.grok: white on the blue switch and letter tile
on-accent.use: white on the indigo fill (Iris 5.4:1); the theme check keeps it at 4.5:1 or switches to the inverted ink

focus.use: the 2px focus ring, the accent's text shade (derived by the theme's contrast check)

attention.use: red now means failed and a destructive confirm only (owner's pick 09 A reverses 'red = you owe')

attention-text.use: 'failed', error lines, a destructive menu item: 6.5:1 dark, 5.6:1 light

attention-soft.use: behind a failed card; the message addressed to you now takes --owe-soft

warn.use: owner's pick (09 A): what the person owes: the needs-you dot, the attention flag, the 'you' capsule's ring, the notch's attention edge

warn-text.use: 'needs you' words and the 'you' capsule: 7.0:1 on #0e0e0e (dark); #a35600 is 4.8:1 on every light surface (Grok's #b25e00 is 4.3:1 on the #f5f5f5 sidebar, so v7 darkens it)

owe.use: what the person owes, as a mark: the needs-you dot, the rail's flag, the 'you' capsule's ring, the notch's edge (owner's pick 09 A). 5.6:1 on #0e0e0e; 3.2:1 on #f5f5f5

owe-text.use: 'needs you', 'Needs you: approve a deploy', the 'you' capsule's word

owe-soft.use: the wash under a message addressed to you

ok.use: the online dot, a connected mark, a passed gate's dot

bubble-agent.use: a bot's message; dark adds the specular ring and a 3% top gradient

bubble-user.use: your message: 18% ink in dark, solid ink in light

find.use: find-in-chat matches; the current match one step stronger

scrim.use: behind dialogs and the palette; never blurred

sans.use: option A of the font board (recommended): Geist, SIL OFL 1.1, already bundled (@fontsource/geist). B: Inter (OFL 1.1). C: Figtree (OFL 1.1)

mono.use: code, paths, numbers that line up, keys. No longer for state words or model names (R-type-1 changes)

tracking.use: letter-spacing of every sans step; --track-s 0.015em at 13px

weights.use: 400 nearly everything (buttons, tabs, menus, rows included); 500 page titles and a bot's name in the title pill; 600 dialog titles and a question card's question. Hierarchy by alpha, not weight

fs-xs.use: timestamps, section headings, tooltips, captions, state words

fs-s.use: settings rows, inputs, row subtitles, palette subtitles

fs-m.use: menus, buttons, the composer, row names, settings labels

fs-xl.use: a page title (500), the bot name field

pill.grok: buttons, chips, toggles, icon buttons, title pill
pill.use: every button, icon button, chip, segmented track and thumb, switch, the title pill, the search pill, the one-line composer, avatars

composer.use: the composer box (a pill at one line, 22 as it grows)

block.use: every inline surface that holds controls: tool rows, files, questions (AskCard), approvals, the queue, notices; the composer's radius, so a 28px control sits 8 from both edges (the corner rule)

bubble.use: messages, question cards, inline cards in a conversation (approval, connector, plan, file)

dialog-form.use: form dialogs (new bot, confirm, a long-text editor), 440 to 488 wide

card.use: settings cards, the large dialogs (Settings, Store, Keyboard), the palette, kanban cards

tile.use: the rail tile, the expanded sidebar row, item marks at 40

field.grok: select trigger 10, menu row 10, toast 10, input 8
field.use: fields, selects, a menu row, toasts, the info banner, wells

nav.use: settings nav rows, palette rows, key chips in a field

tip.use: tooltips, the question card's letter tile

kbd.use: key chips in running text, inline code

slab.use: the dock's slab and flares and the approved notch's shape only: kept so the notch spec (section 2.1) and the dock stay as approved

floor.grok: the smallest nested radius in Grok (menu 16, inset 6, row 10; palette 14, 6, 8)
floor.use: the smallest inner radius of a nested corner

smoothing.use: option B of the radius board (recommended): boopis's continuous corner kept at Grok's radii. Option A sets 0 (Grok's plain arc)

nesting.rule: unchanged from v6 8.2: --r-in = max(--r-floor, --r-outer - --pad); a piece too small to be that round moves in until its curve shares the corner's centre (corners.ts); a round piece in a pill stays a pill. Grok's own numbers already satisfy it, which is why v7 can keep the rule and take Grok's values

dialog.grok: the close button (28) 10 in from a 20 form dialog

card.grok: settings card rows are full-bleed; a nested piece takes 6

bubble.grok: approval card: code box 10 inside an 18 card

block.note: derived so the corner rule holds at every density: a --ctl-s pill control in a Block's corner sits at --r-block - --ctl-s/2 (8 at regular's 28; compact and comfortable move it with --ctl-s); text rows indent 4 more

nesting.corner_rule: R-corner-10 (23 Nov): a control nested in a container's corner zone (both insets under the container's radius) has radius = outer - inset and equal insets, and never runs past the container. Blocking in the lab (concentric check).

named.bubble-gap: 6 between consecutive bubbles of one sender, 16 between senders, 24 to a time separator
named.settings-row: 16 horizontal, 44 to 52 tall by content; card padding 8 0

ctl-card.grok: a button inside a settings card 32

hit-min.grok: 28 composer buttons (Grok gap 3 says 32; 28 keeps the composer's geometry and passes WCAG 2.5.8)

drag-h.grok: the top 56 is a drag region, no bar drawn

col-w.grok: the column is the bubbles' width; the composer is wider

orbs.use: 10 the dock pill, 16 the activity line and card minis, 20 lists and mentions, 24 the title pill and room bylines, 28 the compact rail, 36 the rail tile and sidebar rows, 40 the dock row, 64 the details header, 96 the new-bot preview

dark.rule: no shadows. Depth is surface steps (#0e0e0e < #121212 < #161616 < #1f1f1f < #2c2c2c), a 1 device px --line outline, and an inset --spec top and bottom line
dark.--elev-3: inset 0 1px 0 var(--spec-strong) on the top-most floating layer only

light.rule: option A of the light-shadow board (recommended): Grok's shadows as measured

hairline.value: 1 device px (0.5px at 2x, 0.625px at 1.6x); the squircle snaps it as in v6 8.1

--spring.use: layout travel: sidebar, panel, tiles; unchanged

--ease-drawer.use: the details pane and side sheets

--dur-pop.use: menus, popovers, tooltips, the palette: from scale(.98) and 2-4px toward the anchor

--dur-slide.use: the sidebar, the rail tiles, a segmented thumb

--dur-3.use: card height (owner decision), the composer's growth, the dock's springs

--dur-shimmer.use: option C of the status board: the activity phrase's sweep

--dur-hold-phrase.use: a status phrase stays at least this long before it changes

motion.reduced: unchanged from v6: durations become 1ms, loops stop (the shimmer included), travel becomes a cross-fade, orbs reduce and never freeze

choices.B: Grok's radii, boopis's continuous corner and concentric rule
choices.C: rounder: every step one notch up (cards 16, dialogs 24, menus 18, bubbles 22), concentric with the 6 menu inset

radii.picked: B default; C offered in theme customization (the coordinator's reading of the owner's 'B and C look good'; the owner can correct it)

choices.C: flat like dark: hairlines and surface steps only

light-shadow.picked: A standard; each theme picks A, B or C

choices.A: orb2 as it is: its dark eyes
choices.B: cut-out eyes: the eyes take the surface colour
choices.C: the orb in a tile (8% fill), as Grok's rail

choices.A: Grok: floating sidebar toggle, title pill (orb + name, opens details), search and details pills; no bar
choices.B: the same plus a centred search pill that keeps boopis's command field
choices.C: an unfilled 40px bar holding v6's controls, no line

chrome.picked: A floating; search default S5: the keyboard-first hint, clickable, opening the palette; the button and the pill as Settings options

hint.place: the drag region's right group, left of the details button, centred on the 36 px controls
hint.rest: 'Search' 13 in --text-quiet and the key chips (ctrl K, cmd K on macOS), no fill
hint.hover_focus: a 28 px pill at --hover, text --text-dim, over --dur-1; focus adds the ring
hint.name: Search, ctrl K

show_search.off: hides the hint; ctrl K still opens the palette

sidebar-tile.picked: A standard; B a setting, and automatic under 1200 px window width

choices.A: Grok: a 44 pill, + left, mic and voice-or-send right, nothing else
choices.B: the pill plus boopis's mode chips (Governed, Smart, the model) on a second line inside, 22 radius once it grows
choices.C: the pill alone, the mode chips as a quiet line under it

composer.picked: C: the mode line under the composer, its items toggleable

smart.what: Smart on, or the pinned model

model.what: the model that will answer, with its provider mark

cost.what: the running total against the cap, '$0.37 of $0.60' (unknown when unknown)

members.what: in a room: '3 members'; replaces mode

composer.where: the composer's + menu > 'Show under the composer' (checks, per composer kind: session, bot, room, dock), and Settings > General > Composer (the same checks, the defaults); kept in core/settings; an empty line collapses to nothing

choices.A: a breathing dot and the phrase (calm pass default)
choices.C: Grok: the live 16px orb and the phrase with a 2.2s shimmer

status.recommended: C for a bot, A where there is no bot
status.picked: bot: C (live orb + shimmer); session (nameless agent): the same shimmer with the answering model's provider logo, animated, in place of the dot

agent_logo.motion: opacity .55 to 1 and scale .92 to 1, 1.4s ease-in-out (the working pulse), the mark in --text-dim, monochrome currentColor
agent_logo.reduced_motion: still, full opacity; the shimmer stops
agent_logo.source: vendor/model-icons (LobeHub, MIT), the mono variant; unknown family = the generic mark, never the phi

choices.A: a collapsed Danger zone at the page's end
choices.B: the overflow menu in the header

danger.recommended: B on sheets and panes, A on Settings pages
danger.picked: hybrid: B (overflow) on panes and sheets, A (collapsed Danger zone) at the end of Settings pages

choices.A: the calm pass's (i): a 12-radius circle, stroke 1.5
choices.B: a filled 16px disc with a knocked-out i
choices.C: no glyph: the label is dotted-underlined and opens the popover

info-glyph.picked: C, the mark, approved (P3); the outline (i) only under forced-colors

reveal.row hover: the hovered row's explained label gets a dotted underline in --text-quiet (2px offset), fading in over --dur-1
reveal.label hover: the popover opens after 300 ms (tooltip timing when warm), 8 from the label
reveal.keyboard: the label is a button in the tab order (only where it explains); focus shows the underline and the ring, Enter or Space opens the popover, Esc closes
reveal.no hover (touch, or hover: none): the underline shows at rest on explained labels only in that mode (there is nothing else to reveal it); a tap opens the popover

choices.A: a centred form dialog (720 x 640, radius 20)
choices.B: a full focused view over the work, the chrome kept

accent.notes: as a non-text fill on #121212 only Iris (3.5:1), Soft indigo (4.2:1) and Violet-indigo (3.1:1) reach 3:1; Indigo and Ultramarine are 3.0:1 there. White on Soft indigo is 4.47:1 (under 4.5)

choices.A: Grok: 'needs you' in warn amber, red only for failed and destructive
choices.B: boopis: what you owe stays red (the 'you' capsule, the notch's edge), in Grok's red values

attention.picked: A: needs-you in amber (--owe #c8770c / text #e28600, #a35600 light); red for failed and destructive confirms. Reverses the 22-23 November red decisions (DESIGN-SYSTEM.md 15.2)

theme.about: what a theme (built-in or custom) can set; everything else is fixed by the system

accent.derived: a contrast check derives --accent-text and --focus for dark (lightened in OKLab until 4.5:1 on --bg-3 and --bg-1) and light (darkened until 4.5:1 on --bg-1), and --on-accent (white, or the inverted ink when white is under 4.5:1); a fill under 3:1 on --bg-2 is lightened (dark) or darkened (light) for marks only

fixed.attention (--owe, amber) and danger (--r: fixed by meaning: they are the two colours a person must recognise in every theme, on the dock and in the notch, and colour-blind safety was checked for these two only; a theme that recoloured them could make 'needs you' look like 'failed' or like the accent
fixed.surfaces and ink: from the two modes; a mod theme still previews colours through the one theme mechanism (owner decision), under the readability guard

bot-colour-bubble.where: a specific bot's own chat only: your bubble and the send button; ink in rooms and in the boopis bot's chat
bot-colour-bubble.derivation: white text if 4.5:1 is reachable by lowering OKLab L by at most 0.08 (the fill is that darkened colour); else the orb colour as is with #121212 text
bot-colour-bubble.settings: Settings > Appearance > Your messages in a bot's colour (on); per bot in its details pane, overriding
bot-colour-bubble.exception: R-colour-8, owner-approved, scoped to that chat's bubble and send button

owner_picks.02: B default, C in theme customization (coordinator's reading)
owner_picks.05: A floating; search always reachable and toggleable; B as a Settings option
owner_picks.06: A standard; B a setting and automatic under 1200 px
owner_picks.08: status C for bots, model logo + shimmer for sessions; danger hybrid; info C with hover reveal (fallback A); long text B
owner_picks.09 attention: A amber; red for failed and destructive
owner_picks.P2: S5 default, the hint clickable; button and pill as Settings options
owner_picks.blanks: sessions only: wait with a countdown (amber, the agent paused), then lapse to a card; bots never have blanks and ask through approval cards with no time limit

mark.about: the one dashed underline (DESIGN-SYSTEM.md 17): feedforward and blanks always visible, info labels revealed on hover or focus

reveal.info labels: hover or focus of the row; at rest under (hover: none)

mark.feedforward_debounce: a reading at most once per 250 ms pause; only new spans draw in

wait_s.setting: Settings > General > Sessions > Wait for my answer

sessions.waiting: amber dashed gap, countdown chip, 'waiting for you'; the bot paused
sessions.filled: solid accent, same reply; the bot resumes
sessions.lapsed: the bot goes on with its guess (shown mark, '(my guess)'); the question stays as a card
sessions.late: the card's answer is sent as a correction

bots.asks_by: approvals, drawn with the AskCard (approval variant), set up beforehand through the rules engine and tiers

blanks.protocol: needs a timed wait on blank.open, a lapse with the guess, and a late fill marked as a correction (docs/PROTOCOL.md, plugins/boopis/exec, rpc/blanks.py)

AskCard.about: one card for everything that waits on the person's answer under a reply (owner's pick, 23 Nov); the reference approval-surfaces.md section 5 should point to
anatomy: head: 12 --text-dim, the asker's 16 px mark or orb, a short line, the state at the end
answers: 28 px chips, the default inverted

variants.question: a session's lapsed blank: the agent's guess as the default chip; answered late = a correction
variants.approval: a bot's ask from approval-surfaces.md: summary, Rule line with link, Hold to allow once / Allow all this turn / Always allow / Deny (esc); no time limit

AskCard.expiry: a bot's card never expires (approval-surfaces section 5, w31/specs d5350c0b); expired applies only to the owner's own sessions and parked steps after 7 days

InlineChip.rule: R-inline-1: text baseline = line baseline (<= 0.5 device px), box optically centred, line height never grows, symmetric padding; inline-level, never flex

permission_scale.fallback: Supervised when the project has no trusted gate
permission_scale.onboarding: asks for the default after the models step

session.right_panel: four fixed tabs: Diff, Files, Terminal, PR (+ side chat while open)

composer_line.quick_menu: from the composer's + or a click on the line; per composer kind; same list as Settings > General > Under the composer
composer_line.narrow: under 900 px branch and context fold into the quick menu

while_running.placeholder: Queue a message, or ctrl Enter to steer

brand.where: a 22 px tile at the lower left of the last agent bubble of a run (30 px gutter), and the head of every agent card

new_session.layout: the v7 layout unchanged; only the canvas above the composer
canvas: greeting in plain text (no mark at rest)
launch row of quiet selectors (folder, worktree, model, effort, how careful -> four rows)
Waiting on you: inbox row, one-line variant
no model: '+ Choose a model' in the accent and a Block with provider sign-ins
usage: the Notice above the composer
new_session.settle: launch-row items move into the composer's line when the session starts, 200ms --ease-sharp

session.rows: R-row-1: menu and list rows are single-line; the name never wraps or shrinks; 12px gap; the description truncates
